name: Odigma Consultancy Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Odigma Consultancy Solutions Ltd is a digital marketing agency in Bangalore[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ODigMa is a digital marketing agency which is a part of Infibeam group. It specialises in digital solutions like website creation and video marketing. Company builds and maintains online presence for brands

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 205 days to 89.4 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.83% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.77 Cr.
